name: AUTOPILOT.OI Video Agent
description_html:
Plan better TikToks in less time.

Studies the niche you describe, writes a week of scripts, plans cuts and captions you then edit in CapCut, writes the post text and suggests a schedule, and reviews your numbers when you paste them in.

What you get: a Claude prompt kit (PDF): the master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a 10 minute setup guide and a tracker.

How it works: you paste the prompt into a Claude Project and run it whenever you need it. It reads what you upload and drafts. You check it, decide and send. It does not edit videos, log into TikTok or post for you on its own.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works, up to 5 Projects) and a Claude account and your TikTok niche and goals.

Education only. Confirm TikTok's current rules and fees in the app. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or TikTok.
